referenceFunction.generalComment: For the average good wagon we assumed that 65% of the transport is performed by closed wagons and 35% by tank wagons. 50% of the wagon in each category are 2 axis vehicles. The life span of one wagon is assumed to be 40 years with a yearly kilometric performance of 21148km, resulting in a life time performance of 845'900 kilometres. The total weight of a wagon is assumed as about 27t); UUID: 87a0bc8c-737e-3f35-a044-ac749a266da5
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This inventory calls processes of material production, representing the material composition of an average goods wagon. For manufacturing, electricity and light oil burned in industrial furnance are included. For the transportation of materials standandard distance are applied.
referenceFunction.name: Goods wagon

geography.text: Manufacturing data reflects an average material consumption of wagons used in Europe.

technology.text: The modelled goods wagons represent different technologies currently in use.

representativeness.extrapolations: Data for three wagon types is used as an estimate for Europe
representativeness.samplingProcedure: The data of the material composition and energy consumption is based on oral communication with an expert of one company.
